negative_findings.description: Despite Slovak-language searching with the exact idiomatic phrases ('pre dodávateľov', 'výberové konanie dodávateľ', 'kódex dodávateľov', 'nákup a obstarávanie'), no dedicated public supplier/vendor page was located for Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, ČSOB Slovensko, 365.bank/Poštová banka, Prima banka, UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, PSS or mBank SK.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only VÚB banka has a confirmed public procurement page (/ludia/nakup-obstaravanie.html). All other SK banks returned merchant-side, product or unrelated results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's core premise: for eight of nine target banks there is no direct, crawlable sourcing channel, so the bypass route must lean on group portals, e-sourcing platforms, and indirect registries rather than bank websites.

negative_findings.description: The Slovak/English term 'portál' + 'dodávateľ'/'supplier' for Tatra banka is dominated by MERCHANT acquiring products: 'Obchodnícky portál TB', 'Portál na splátky TB', 'Merchant portal'. Similar noise appears for other banks where 'dodávateľ' refers to the customer's own suppliers (e.g. VÚB fraud-warning page 'Pozor na falošných dodávateľov').
negative_findings.result_summary: Supplier-portal queries return acquiring/merchant product pages, not procurement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated keyword sweep must exclude 'obchodník', 'merchant', 'akceptácia kariet', 'splátky' and fraud-advisory pages, or precision collapses.

negative_findings.description: https://www.vub.sk/ludia/nakup-obstaravanie.html returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain automated fetch, while search-engine snippets confirm substantive procurement content on the page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot defence on vub.sk; content exists and is public in a browser. NOT recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most valuable direct source in this cell requires a browser-grade collector; a naive HTTP pipeline would wrongly mark the cell's best source as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: No public supplier-registration URL was found for Erste Group Procurement, Raiffeisen Bank International, KBC or UniCredit despite English, German and Italian searching. Only Intesa Sanpaolo's Portale Fornitori has a confirmed public self-registration endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: 1 of 5 relevant banking groups exposes a publicly addressable supplier portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For Erste/RBI/KBC/UniCredit the sourcing channel is likely invitation-only or behind an unadvertised Ariba/Coupa tenant, meaning tender visibility for SLSP, Tatra banka, ČSOB and UniCredit SK must come from indirect signals (contracts, references, personnel, vendor press releases), not portals.

negative_findings.description: For mBank Slovensko no Slovak-language procurement or supplier vocabulary surfaced at all; the entity operates as a branch of Polish mBank S.A. and any sourcing terminology would be Polish ('dostawcy', 'zakupy', 'przetarg'), which was not searched in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: mBank SK supplier channel unmapped; no sk-language footprint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Language coverage for this actor is incomplete and must be closed with Polish-language search before mBank can be called a dead end.

coverage_gaps.description: Polish-language search for mBank S.A. supplier/procurement channels ('dostawcy', 'zakupy', 'przetarg', 'portal dostawcy') was not performed; Czech-language search for ČSOB group procurement ('dodavatelé', 'nákup', 'výběrové řízení') was also not performed even though ČSOB SK sits under the CZ/KBC structure.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass in pl and cs against mbank.pl, csob.cz and kbc-group service-company domains.

coverage_gaps.description: No check was made of whether SK banks run sourcing through group IT/shared-service subsidiaries that DO publish tenders (e.g. Erste's service companies, KBC Global Services CZ, PB Servis / SKPAY in the 365.bank group, VÚB Generali, Tatra-Leasing).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate each bank's Slovak subsidiaries via ORSR/FinStat and repeat the supplier-page sweep at subsidiary level; several of these are more likely than the bank to publish a tender.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak commercial e-sourcing platforms (JOSEPHINE/PROEBIZ, ERANET, TENDERnet, evo.gov.sk, EVOSERVIS) were identified but not systematically queried for bank buyers; whether any of the nine target banks has a buyer profile there is untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a name/IČO sweep for all nine banks and their subsidiaries across the public listing pages of each Slovak e-sourcing platform; a single hit would convert an invisible channel into a monitorable feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Two high-yield indirect Slovak registries were not queried in this run: CRZ (Centrálny register zmlúv, crz.gov.sk) and RPVS (Register partnerov verejného sektora, rpvs.gov.sk). Banks and their vendors appear in both, and RPVS discloses beneficial owners of any company contracting with the state.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add crz.gov.sk and rpvs.gov.sk sweeps keyed on bank IČOs and on known banking-technology vendors as a standing indirect feed.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side disclosure was not scouted: technology suppliers routinely publish reference/case-study announcements naming the SK bank that awarded them work, which is often the ONLY public trace of a private-bank RFP outcome.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a vendor-press-release and reference-page watchlist (core banking, ATM/self-service, card processing, cash handling, IT integrators active in SK) as a complementary indirect route.

brief: Slovakia's systemic banks are private and outside ÚVO, and this scouting run confirms the consequence empirically: of the nine target banks, only VÚB publishes a genuine Slovak-language procurement page (vub.sk/ludia/nakup-obstaravanie.html, bot-defended with HTTP 403 to plain fetch), and only one of five parent groups - Intesa Sanpaolo - exposes a publicly addressable supplier portal with open self-registration. Erste Group Procurement, RBI, KBC and UniCredit are structurally identifiable as the real sourcing decision points for SLSP, Tatra banka, ČSOB SK and UniCredit SK, but none advertises a reachable registration endpoint, so their tender flow is effectively invitation-only. The practical bypass therefore runs through three secondary channels: Slovak commercial e-sourcing platforms (JOSEPHINE/PROEBIZ, ERANET) which private buyers also use, public-sector proxies such as Slovenská pošta for the 365.bank ecosystem, and supplier-side records in ÚVO/uvostat, CRZ and RPVS. Local-language coverage was achieved in sk (plus de/it/en at group level) but is still missing in pl for mBank and cs for the ČSOB/KBC stack.
